CODE FINDINGS (6)

CRITICAL
  [py.sqli] SQL Injection
    location:   api/reports.py:142
    cwe:        CWE-89 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html)
    category:   Injection
    confidence: HIGH
    snippet:
        141| owner = request.args["user"]
      > 142| cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM reports WHERE owner = '{owner}'")
        143| rows = cur.fetchall()
    what's wrong: Request-controlled `owner` is interpolated into the SQL string.
    vulnerable:   cur.execute(f"... owner = '{owner}'")
    secure:       cur.execute("... owner = %s", (owner,))
    cves:         CVE-2019-19844, CVE-2021-23336

  [js.command_injection] Command Injection
    location:   worker/convert.js:88
    cwe:        CWE-78 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html)
    category:   Injection
    confidence: MEDIUM
    snippet:
      >  88| exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
    what's wrong: Untrusted `src` is concatenated into a shell command.
    vulnerable:   exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
    secure:       execFile("ffmpeg", ["-i", src, "out.mp4"])

HIGH
  [py.hardcoded_secret] Hardcoded Credentials
    location:   config/settings.py:12
    cwe:        CWE-798 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html)
    category:   Secrets
    confidence: HIGH
    snippet:
      >  12| STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_abcd" + "••••"
    what's wrong: A live API key is committed to source control.
    vulnerable:   STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_********"
    secure:       STRIPE_KEY = os.environ["STRIPE_KEY"]

MEDIUM
  [py.weak_hash] Weak Password Hashing
    location:   auth/users.py:57
    cwe:        CWE-328 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/328.html)
    category:   Crypto
    confidence: MEDIUM
    snippet:
      >  57| digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    what's wrong: MD5 is unsuitable for password storage.
    vulnerable:   hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
    secure:       bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt())

LOW
  [py.open_redirect] Open Redirect
    location:   web/views.py:203
    category:   Config
    confidence: LOW
    snippet:
      > 203| return redirect(request.args["next"])
    what's wrong: User-supplied `next` is used as a redirect target unchecked.
    vulnerable:   return redirect(request.args["next"])
    secure:       return redirect(url_for(safe_endpoint(request.args)))
